name: CrowdStrike
summary: Endpoint protection built around a cloud-delivered agent: antivirus, EDR and threat hunting.
best_for: small and mid-size companies that want a serious endpoint agent without running a security team — Falcon Go is genuinely priced for businesses under 100 devices
skip_if: you are under ten devices and already run a maintained operating system with its built-in protection, because at that size the management overhead outweighs the gain; also skip Go if you actually need EDR, since that starts a tier up
honest_knock: Two numbers decide whether this is for you, and neither is the headline. The first is the 100-device ceiling on Falcon Go: it is not a soft limit you grow through, it is the point where you change product. The second is the annual rate, which is worth doing the division on — $59.99 a year against $7.99 a month is $95.88, so annual saves 37%, one of the larger annual discounts in security software. Beyond that, be honest with yourself about which tier you are comparing: Go is antivirus with a good agent, and the endpoint detection and response that CrowdStrike is famous for starts at Pro. Comparing Go against a full EDR product from a competitor is comparing the wrong things.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Falcon Go · per device per month, or $59.99 per device a year
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on crowdstrike.com/en-us/pricing/falcon-go/ from a Netherlands exit; all six amounts unchanged since 1 Aug 2026 and the page states 'All prices listed are in US Dollars' with no regional list) Priced per device. Falcon Go $7.99 per device per month, or $59.99 per device billed annually — capped at a maximum of 100 devices. Falcon Pro $14.99 monthly or $99.99 annually per device. Falcon Enterprise $19.99 per device per month, or $184.99 per device billed annually — a rate the 1 Aug reading recorded as unpublished. Larger tiers and managed services are quote-only. The free trial is a single 15-day Falcon Free Trial covering Next-Gen Antivirus, Device Control and Express Support, not a trial of each paid tier. Annual subscriptions are billed in full at the start of the term and can be cancelled within 30 days for a full refund.

compare_with.name: SentinelOne or Microsoft Defender for Business
compare_with.why: the direct endpoint peers — Defender is often already in your Microsoft licence, so price that first before comparing per-device rates
